findings.summary: the admin shell logs a router «Navigation cancelled» pair on every signed-in journey
findings.detail: Seen 2 times here and identically in workforce-flag-lever, growth-privacy-queue and margin-recipe-to-margin. It is AdminPage's login redirect being superseded by the storeId append, not anything on /admin/workforce-personnel-list. Recorded so it is not re-diagnosed from this page.
